summary: Iteration 2 focused verification of the team-tagged expenses fix. Backend: new pytest module /app/backend/tests/test_team_expenses.py - 10/10 passed (team_expenses field on GET /api/teams, POST /api/expenses with/without team_id, invalid team_id -> 400, PUT preserves team, agent/anon 403, month summary reconciliation). Frontend E2E (admin nestinfradevelopers39@gmail.com): Add Expense dialog exposes 'Team (optional)' select with Falcons/Strikers/Titans; created expense (2026-08-20, Travel, 1500, Falcons, Test Admin) -> 'Expense added' toast, row shows Team=Falcons and Rs.1,500; Teams page showed team-expenses = ['Rs.1,500','Rs.0','Rs.0'] (Falcons 1,500); edit dialog on a seeded expense (Meta Ads / 25000) prefilled and saved; expense deleted and all team cards returned to Rs.0; summary cards reconcile (75,000 + 0 + 74,500 = 149,500). Agent NIA001: no Expenses nav, direct /expenses redirects to dashboard. No blocking issues found; test data cleaned up.

minor.issue: team_expenses (company expense data) is returned to agent-role users too (endpoint uses get_current_user). Agents therefore see 'Team Expenses (this month)' on the Teams page even though /api/expenses is admin-only. Confirm this is intended, otherwise restrict the field for non-admins.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog title reads 'Edit Expense' when adding a new expense, because initial={date: today} is always truthy (title uses form.initial ? 'Edit Expense' : 'Add Expense'). Use an explicit flag e.g. form.initial?.id.

issues: Sonner toast renders top-right and overlaps the 'Create Team' button while visible (transient, but blocks the click area).
Radix console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y).

action_items: Fix Add-Expense dialog title showing 'Edit Expense' (use form.initial?.id for the title condition).
Decide whether team_expenses should be hidden from agent-role users on GET /api/teams / Teams page.
Optional: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to FormDialog to clear the Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: masters.py list_teams() loads all sales, all expenses of the month and all agents into memory and filters in Python; fine at seed scale but should move to aggregation pipelines as data grows.

Expenses.jsx/Teams.jsx: Teams page uses currentMonth() only (no month picker), so 'Team Expenses (this month)' can never be inspected for a past month while the Expenses page has a month filter - inconsistent UX.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted temporary expenses (TEST_QA_team_expense 1500 Falcons, TEST_no_team, TEST_edit). All removed; team expenses back to Rs.0 and expense month total back to 148,000.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team-expenses fix is verified end-to-end (backend + UI). Reusable backend regression module: /app/backend/tests/test_team_expenses.py (uses conftest fixtures admin/agent/anon/base_url, MONTH=2026-08). Note the FormDialog uses NATIVE <select> elements, so use page.select_option with data-testid='<formtestid>-field-<name>'. Only open issues are cosmetic: Add dialog titled 'Edit Expense', and agents can see team_expenses.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug (expenses missing from team structure) is resolved: ExpenseIn now accepts team_id, expense_doc resolves team_name, and list_teams aggregates month expenses by team_id into team_expenses, rendered as data-testid='team-expenses-<id>'. Verified aggregation increments/decrements correctly on create/delete.
